title: FACS Staining of PBMCs for TLR and Intracellular Staining
author: Marloes Van Splunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.87qhzmw
materials:
Protocol FACS panel FACS buffer: PBS Lonza + 2mM EDTA(Merck CBI 108418); 0,5% BSA (Roche 10735086001); 0,01% NaN3 ( Merck CBI 822335) PBS: PBS Lonza BE17-516Q/12 IC kit: Intracellular Fixation & permeabilization buffer kit 88-882400 Ebioscience (125 ml) containing Fix buffer(Ebioscience 00-8222-49); Permeabilization buffer (Ebioscience 00-
8333-56, 10x concentrated) dilute in MilliQ water 1. PBMC isolation  see leucosep PBMCs isolation protocol 2. Count cells using Beckman Coulter Cell counter. i. Add 10 ml filtered Isotone in Accuvette ii. Add 3 drops of ZAP-oGlobulinII iii. Add 20 ul of cell suspension iv. Mix gently and avoid airbubbles and incubate for 2’ v. Calculate cell concentration and resuspend cells in 2 ml RPMI+ medium 3. Divide cells over the different assays, in the following priority (I-V) I. 2*106 PBMCs/ well (NUNC plate)  TLR panel FACS  continue with step 4  9. II. A cell suspension of 4*106PBMCs/ml is made of the PBMCs for action III and IV. III. 5x 2*106PBMCs/well (12 wells) + 5 stimulations with BFA (medium, Pam3CysK, LPS, R848, CpG)  cytokine panel FACS (1ml in total/well; single wells)  step 5 IV. 5x 1*106PBMCs/well (24 wells plate) + 5 stimulations (medium, Pam3CysK, LPS, R848, CpG)  sups 24h cytokine (0.5 ml in total /well ; in duplo if possible) step 6  step 8  step 9 V. Cryopreserve rest of cells (5x106 / vial)  step 7 & protocol crypreservation of PBMCs When not enough cells are presented the first assay to be adapted is: 1. IV  from duplo to single wells per stimulation 2. V  no cryopreservation 3. IV  no 24h sups at all.

steps.title: Plate TLR panel cells
steps.instruction: Add 2 × 10⁶ PBMCs per well into a NUNC plate, then spin at 400 g for 3 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Plate cytokine stimulation (3 h)
steps.instruction: In a 12‑well plate, plate 5 wells with 2 × 10⁶ PBMCs per well (0.5 ml cell suspension each). Add 0.5 ml of each stimulation (RPMI, Pam, LPS, R848, CpG) together with Brefeldin A, mix to 1 ml total, and incubate for 3 h.

steps.title: Plate cytokine stimulation (24 h)
steps.instruction: In a 24‑well plate, plate 5 wells (duplicate if possible) with 1 × 10⁶ PBMCs per well (0.25 ml cell suspension each). Add 0.25 ml of the corresponding stimulation (RPMI, Pam, LPS, R848, CpG) without Brefeldin A (final volume 0.5 ml) and incubate for 24 h; record the start time.

steps.title: Cryopreserve leftover cells
steps.instruction: Freeze any remaining PBMCs according to the laboratory cryopreservation protocol.

steps.title: Harvest cells after 3 h stimulation
steps.instruction: Spin the cytokine‑stimulation plate at 200 g for 5 min, discard 500 µl supernatant, then transfer the cells to a 96‑well NUNC polypropylene plate (500 µl wells) using a 1 ml pipette with the following motion: pipet twice in an “X”, twice as a “+”, and three times around the side of the well. Perform this for 2–3 wells and verify under a microscope before proceeding.

steps.title: First wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl FACS buffer to each well, spin at 400 g for 3 min at 4 °C, then discard the supernatant by emptying the plate above a sink.

steps.title: Surface marker staining
steps.instruction: Prepare 110 µl FACS buffer containing the extracellular surface‑marker antibody cocktail and Fc block (prepared the day before). Add 100 µl of this mixture to each well, resuspend cells, and incubate for 30 min on ice protected from light with aluminium foil.

steps.title: Wash after surface staining
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with 200 µl PBS, each time spinning at 400 g for 3 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Live/Dead staining
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh Aqua Live/Dead (FVD520) solution: 1 µl dye per 1000 µl PBS for every 10 × 10⁶ PBMCs. Add 100 µl of this solution to each well (add conjugated streptavidin if required), then incubate for 20 min in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Add buffer before final spin
steps.instruction: Add 180 µl FACS buffer to each well.

steps.title: Final spin before intracellular staining
steps.instruction: Spin the plate for 3 min at 400 g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Fix cells (intracellular)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl IC fixation buffer to each well, resuspend, and incubate 30 min in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl cold 1× Perm buffer to each well, then spin at 400 g for 3 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash twice with 200 µl 1× Perm buffer, each wash followed by a spin for 3 min at 400 g at room temperature.

steps.title: Intracellular antibody staining
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of the intracellular antibody mix (prepared in Perm buffer the day before) to each well and incubate 20 min in the dark in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Wash post intracellular staining
steps.instruction: Wash twice with 200 µl 1× Perm buffer, each wash followed by a spin for 3 min at 400 g at room temperature.

steps.title: Acquire TLR panel data
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 300 µl FACS buffer, then run on a FACS CANTO II for 240 s at medium flow rate with a threshold of 45 000.

steps.title: Acquire cytokine panel data
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 250 µl FACS buffer, then run on a FACS Canto II for 200 s at medium flow rate with a threshold of 45 000.
